test_cases.fr_text: Mutations to project entities must bump the corresponding revision rev bigint counter via PostgreSQL database triggers.
Outgoing webhook HTTP POST dispatches must compute and include an HMAC-SHA256 signature in the request headers using the webhook secret.
Webhooks failing repeatedly must back off exponentially and auto-disable isActive = false upon exceeding consecutive failure limits.
Realtime streaming: log updates and AG-UI events must stream unbuffered in real time.
Direct database insertions/updates to itsaplan.issue from external bridge daemons must satisfy project integrity, column assignment, and chk_done_proof_and_review constraints.
test_cases.description: External bridge CDC upsert satisfies constraints

test_cases.fr_text: External or internal mutations to issue rows must atomically fire trigger bump_revision(), incrementing revision.rev for scope board:<projectId> to notify frontend SyncProvider.
test_cases.description: Database issue mutation bumps revision counter atomically

input.mutation: UPDATE issue SET priority = 'high' WHERE id = 1

test_cases.fr_text: Bridge insertion with invalid column ID or non-existent project key must be rejected cleanly.
test_cases.description: Adversarial invalid project or column rejection
